dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "The Stadium will undergo a period of maintenance after the Pilgrimage, and will not (in principle) be used for any other purpose."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "Please note that engaging in 'exchanging pointers' at the Stadium's main arena or performing rehearsals for future tournaments without prior notice is prohibited."
